pagesAdded.notes: 唯一 /leave 入口。?tab=mine|requests|types|policies|balances|calendar|reports 仅页面状态；非法或不授权的 tab 回落 mine。页面提供 loading|empty|unconfigured|forbidden|error|success 六态及 partial 提示；各面板有独立加载/空/错误提示。管理 tab 只有具备 time.leave.admin / time.leave.type.manage / time.leave.policy.read / time.leave.ledger.read / time.leave.report.read 时出现。

openapiOperations: GET /v1/time/leave/types (add status, policy_version, entitlement_minutes; keep list envelope)
POST /v1/time/leave/types (201/401/403/404/409/422; Idempotency-Key required; code/unit immutable onCreate)
PATCH /v1/time/leave/types/{id} (200/401/403/404/409/422; Idempotency-Key required; rejects code/unit changes)
GET /v1/time/leave/policies (read leave_policy_versions only; no expiry_rule_json; capability time.leave.policy.read)
GET /v1/time/leave/requests (self list by default; scope=all for MANAGED/COMPANY; filters employment_id/leave_type_id/org_unit_id/state/from/to/page/page_size)
POST /v1/time/leave/preview (self only; employment_id is not a subject selector)
POST /v1/time/leave/requests (self only; supplied employment_id is validated then ignored)
POST /v1/time/leave/requests/on-behalf (201/401/403/404/409/422; explicit employment_id required and never equal to actor employment)
POST /v1/time/leave/requests/{caseId}/cancel (200/401/403/404/409; self cancel of SUBMITTED releases reservation; body {reason, revoke?})

POST /v1/time/leave/requests/{caseId}/cancel with revoke=true (200/401/403/404/409; time.leave.admin only; frozen period 409 LEAVE_PERIOD_FROZEN) and optional admin alias POST /v1/time/leave/requests/{caseId}/revoke
GET /v1/time/leave/ledger (self by default; employment_id drill-down requires time.leave.admin and row scope)
GET /v1/time/leave/reports/summary (200/401/403/404/422; rows,total,as_of,source_hash; SELF returns only own rows)

payrollIntegration.requiredProductionBinding: A Payroll-owned adapter (recommended App\Modules\Payroll\Adapters\TimePayrollPeriodLockReader) implementing App\Modules\Time\Contracts\PayrollPeriodLockReader, bound in backend/app/Modules/Payroll/Providers/PayrollServiceProvider.php.
payrollIntegration.adapterQuery: Read payroll_run_employees joined to payroll_runs for the employment and period; treat PUBLISHED, PAID and CLOSED (or the project's equivalent frozen statuses) as frozen. Type the query against Payroll models/services; Time must never query payroll tables directly.
payrollIntegration.failClosed: PayrollFreezeGuard treats an unbound contract, a container error, or a thrown reader error as 409 data.reason=LEAVE_PERIOD_FROZEN with data.failure=PAYROLL_LOCK_READER_UNAVAILABLE or PAYROLL_LOCK_READ_FAILED. A true result returns 409 data.reason=LEAVE_PERIOD_FROZEN and data.period=YYYY-MM.

workflowIntegration.requiredChange: Bind this Time-owned approval effect to the Workflow effect handler in the Workflow module/provider so an approved leave posts CONSUME idempotently after releasing the submit-time RESERVE. The current NullEffectHandler leaves APPROVED projections unconsumed.
workflowIntegration.idempotency: applyApprovedCase is safe to replay: APPROVED/CONSUMED/REVOKED return replayed=true without writing a second CONSUME.

migrationChanges.notes: Adds leave_types.status; adds actor_user_id/org_unit_id/leave_policy_version_id to leave_request_projections; creates leave_policy_versions; backfills one PUBLISHED COMPANY version per existing leave type (version 1, 2026-01-01..9999-12-31, accrual minutes from annual_entitlement_days at the configured standard day, fallback 480). Forward-only; down() intentionally performs no destructive rollback.

notes: 唯一事实源：leave_types 只保留身份/展示（code,name,unit,is_statutory,is_annual,requires_attachment,allow_negative,status）；额度、carryover/expiry、applies_to、min notice、max consecutive、附件阈值、法律依据只在 leave_policy_versions。旧列保留为兼容只读列，Leave 服务不再从旧规则列读取或写入规则。
规则 append 在事务中锁定 leave_type 行后计算 max(version)+1；同类型未退休 PUBLISHED 版本区间重叠返回 409 LEAVE_POLICY_RANGE_OVERLAP；retire 只允许尚未生效且未被未来 SUBMITTED/APPROVED 申请引用的版本。

本人代申请拆分：POST /requests 与 /preview 只使用 session.employment_id（客户端 employment_id 被校验后忽略）；代申请使用独立 POST /requests/on-behalf + /preview 和独立能力，要求显式 employment_id、actor employment 与 subject 不同、先过 TimeRequestScope，越权统一 404。
workingDays 逐日走公司 BusinessCalendar（周末/节假日不计假），preview 与 submit 都调用同一规则/日历/重叠校验；overlap 查询覆盖 SUBMITTED/APPROVED/CONSUMED 并按 from_date<=to and to_date>=from 判断，不只是同起止日期。

撤销/销假：SUBMITTED 走 RELEASE + workflow withdraw + state=CANCELLED；APPROVED/CONSUMED 走 Payroll freeze guard + REVERSE CONSUME + state=REVOKED；重复终态调用返回 replay/no-op。本人 cancel 与管理员 revoke 是不同路由/能力，本人不能通过 time.leave.admin 提权。
所有写命令使用 CommandRunner + Idempotency-Key，并在 service 内写审计（type.created/updated、policy.published/retired、request.submitted/on_behalf_submitted、request.cancelled/revoked、request.approved）。
前端策略页只显示业务字段中文标签（关联假别、版本、额度、发放周期、提前申请、连续上限、附件阈值、生效/失效日期、状态、备注），不显示 technical enum 或原始 JSON；新增/停用均调用真实接口并使用新的幂等键。
